subject: Pilot planning: slotting evaluation kickoff and success criteria

Cc: Jamie Lowe <jamie.lowe@cardiohealth.co>
Date: Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 16:05 PDT
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps

Thanks for the recap, Neha — excited about the options we discussed. Two quick priorities from our side: (1) schedule the technical deep dive so our infra team can validate throughput assumptions; (2) lock down an evaluation kickoff window (2–4 week pilot) with success criteria so procurement has something concrete.

Availability: myself and Jamie are open week of May 3–7 in the mornings (PST) — can you propose 2 slots? Also — we’d like a short pre-kickoff checklist (what you need from us: sample prompt set, dataset slices, and any nonce keys).

Best,
Alex
Senior PM, CardioHealth

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jamie Lowe <jamie.lowe@cardiohealth.co>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, Apr 21, 2027 at 09:14 PDT
Subject: RE: Discovery recap + next steps

Alex — great to hear. Proposed plan below so we can align calendars quickly:  

1) Technical deep dive (60m) — propose Tue, May 4 at 10:00am PST or Thu, May 6 at 9:00am PST. Ben will lead kernel/throughput discussion and sizing.
2) Eval kickoff (30m) — Mon, May 10 at 11:00am PST. We’ll confirm pilot scope (2 weeks), success criteria, and prompt set handoff.

Pre-kickoff asks (short checklist):
- CardioHealth to provide 10–20 representative prompts + 2 CSV samples (PII redacted)
- Contact for infra (SSH/JWKS if you want us to test VPC peering later)
- Any compliance constraints (retention, HIPAA notes)

Attaching a one-page pilot checklist and our standard trial SLA for procurement. I’ll have Ben and Marissa on the call to cover ops and CS readiness. If those slots don’t work, send 2 alternatives and we’ll pivot.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0124
attachments: cardio-pilot-checklist.pdf, redwood-trial-sla.pdf

Alex/Jamie — thanks for the quick replies. Confirming our plan and links below:  

1) Technical deep dive — Tue, May 4, 2027 · 10:00–11:00am PST (Google Meet): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=ckV4YW1wbGUtY2FsZW5kYXI
2) Evaluation kickoff (30m) — Mon, May 10, 2027 · 11:00–11:30am PST (placeholder invite sent)

Prework checklist (short):
- CardioHealth: share 10–20 prompt examples in the linked Doc (we’ll tag them for eval buckets) — https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcd-MAP-pilot-mpa
- Redwood: provide a small token-distribution sample and recommended batching profile during the tech deep dive
- Procurement: draft SLA/term questions — I attached the trial SLA for procurement visibility.

Success criteria (draft for kickoff):
- >90% pass rate on the prompt acceptance set (per CardioHealth rubric)
- Median latency < 250ms tail at 95th percentile for the sample workload
- No data exposure incidents and agreed retention window set

I’ve also pasted a short mutual action plan into the shared Doc and pinged procurement on the HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/98765. If anything changes, flag here and we’ll update the invites.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
